tools.name: find_paid_service
tools.description: Search Verantis's verified directory of machine-payable services (x402, MPP). Results are UNIFIED per service (host): each carries its settlement rails ('rails': base / solana / tempo), and every rail has its OWN reputation, price, and buyer retention — never blended. Pass 'chain' and 'matched_rail' marks that chain's rail so you see the reputation for the rail you'll actually pay on. 'coming_soon' lists advertised chains not yet measured. Prefer verified=true before paying anyone.

query.description: what you need, e.g. 'twitter data', 'web search', 'rpc ethereum'

verified_only.description: only services that passed the latest live probe

max_price_usd.description: max price per call in USD

chain.description: settlement network, e.g. base, solana, polygon, tempo

protocol.description: restrict to one payment protocol: x402 or mpp

limit.description: maximum number of results to return (default 10)

min_score.description: minimum trust score 0-100 — set high (e.g. 85) for money-moving tasks

exclude_concentrated.description: exclude services from operators with many listings under one registrable owner (a neutral concentration signal, not a fraud claim)

proven_only.description: only services that have EARNED reputation over time (excludes 'new' services and 'watch' services whose on-chain payments are concentrated / not yet broadly distributed). Reputation is earned via consistent history + on-chain buyer retention; a brand-new well-behaved service is verified but new, not top-trust.

require_fresh.description: live re-probe stale results before returning — use before paying real money; adds ~1s per stale service

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Full unified record for one service host: every settlement rail it accepts on, each with its own reputation, price, buyers, volume and history, plus coming-soon chains. Pass the host (domain).

domain.description: the service host / domain to look up, e.g. api.nansen.ai

tools.name: directory_stats
tools.description: Index-level statistics: services, verification breakdown, data freshness.

tools.name: check_wallet
tools.description: Check a recipient wallet BEFORE your agent pays it — a pre-payment guard. Pass the pay-to address a service asked you to pay; returns whether Verantis knows the wallet, its EARNED reputation tier, and human-readable reasons. A wallet IS a settlement rail, so the reply names the rail it settles on ('rail': chain + protocols), its host, on-chain buyer retention (distinct buyers, repeat rate, distribution), and the host's OTHER rails ('also_settles_on'). If 'shared_wallet' is true the address fronts many services (a relay/treasury) so the reputation reflects the pool, not one service — treat with care. An unknown or low-reputation recipient is a reason to pause.

pay_to.description: recipient wallet address (0x… for Base/EVM, base58 for Solana)
